# Conversations

[English](conversations.md) | [简体中文](../zh-CN/api-reference/conversations.md)

[Back to the API Reference index](README.md)

Conversation lists, details, members, read state, mute state, pinning, and labels.

## Operations on this page

- [`deleteConversationLabel`](#delete-conversation-label): Delete a conversation label
- [`getConversation`](#get-conversation): Get conversation details
- [`listConversationLabels`](#list-conversation-labels): List conversation labels
- [`listConversationMembers`](#list-conversation-members): List conversation members
- [`listConversations`](#list-conversations): List conversations
- [`markConversationRead`](#mark-conversation-read): Mark a conversation as read
- [`markConversationUnread`](#mark-conversation-unread): Mark a conversation as unread
- [`muteConversation`](#mute-conversation): Mute a conversation
- [`pinConversation`](#pin-conversation): Pin a conversation
- [`setConversationLabelMembers`](#set-conversation-label-members): Add or remove a conversation label
- [`unmuteConversation`](#unmute-conversation): Unmute a conversation
- [`unpinConversation`](#unpin-conversation): Unpin a conversation
- [`upsertConversationLabel`](#upsert-conversation-label): Create or update a conversation label
